bullets.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching for Italy
bullets.note: ([Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/stanley-tucci-searching-for-italy/umc.cmc.2yiricezxngkbyfosdt8fzq0), [YouTube TV](https://tv.youtube.com/browse/stanley-tucci--searching-for-italy-UC9VQurSZt5Ffo8ZjkhDRlYg), [CNNgo](https://go.cnn.com/vod)). This show is simply beautiful. Description: “_Stanley Tucci: Searching for Italy_ is a six-part CNN Original Series that follows Academy Award nominee Stanley Tucci \[[@stanleytucci](https://www.instagram.com/stanleytucci/)\] as he travels across Italy to discover the secrets and delights of the country’s regional cuisines. Follow along as Tucci explores how Italian cooking offers a glimpse into the country’s rich history and culture.” The series received two Primetime Emmy Award nominations, and it was renewed for a second season. Kudos to the executive producers ([Adam Hawkins](https://twitter.com/adamhawkinstv?lang=en), [Eve Kay](https://www.evekay.tv/), [Stanley Tucci](https://www.instagram.com/stanleytucci/) for [RAW](https://www.raw.co.uk/stanley-tucci-searching-for-italy); [Amy Entelis](https://www.cnn.com/profiles/amy-entelis-profile) and [Lyle Gamm](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0303962/) for CNN Original Series) and the different directors ([Satiyesh Manoharajah](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm1774665/), [Neil Ferguson](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm1990454/), [Chiara Messineo](https://chiaramessineo.com/), [Archie Powell](http://archiepowellfilms.online/), and [Chloë Avery](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2349882/)). Watch a short preview [here](https://www.instagram.com/p/CLP1-brgQ5l/).
